name: goal-run-2026-09-16
source: The goal run of docs/images/window-goal-2026-09-16.png, as the page messages cli/crow_gui.py pushes for it. Texts and numbers follow the approved mockup Crow/02_docs/mockup-crow-gui-redesign-2026-10-14/Main.dc.html (Obsidian vault).
notes: Taken from the screenshot and the mockup: prompt, goal and its three steps with their times and tokens, the eleven tool calls in order, the arguments and results the mockup shows, subtask d1, the answer, the cost line numbers, the 82 % thought share, 6.1k of 200k context.

Fixture, not measured: the one-line thoughts, the per-call tool seconds, model_s and tool_s (chosen so that decode_s + prefill_s <= model_s and model_s + tool_s = waited_s), the message counts and titles of the other chats in the rail, and the archived chat.

cost.share is a percentage (the page prints share.toFixed(0)), so 0.82 is stored as 82.0. cost.line is TurnCost.line() for cost.stats; cost.stats mirrors TurnCost.record() as #382 adds it. test_render_window.py holds the line, the answer blocks and the argument summaries against the core.
Calls the mockup shows without arguments or a result (goal_step x5, the first run_command, collect) are sent without them: tool and toolend, no toolres.
